properties.statement: Wrote a throwaway Python script over the committed export to ask how a Verification's executable form was actually DRAWN: for each check with an IMPLEMENTS edge, whether the same artifact also has a REALIZES to it (so link_artifact was used and an edge added by hand) or only IMPLEMENTS (so create_edge was used alone) — and, in the other direction, how many checks carry a REALIZES from a registered file and no IMPLEMENTS at all. The answers (30 of 31, and 40) are what turned a mechanism I had just hit by hand into a measured cause. Nothing served answers "which tool wrote this edge", or even "which edges does this pair of nodes have between them" as a single question; the closest served reads are per-node.
